1584        /**
1585         * Removes any people with this same post from the market.
1586         * @param market
1587         * @param postI
1588         * @param person
1589         */
1590        public static void assignPost(MarketAPI market, String postId, PersonAPI person) {
1591                for (PersonAPI curr : market.getPeopleCopy()) {
1592                        if (postId.equals(curr.getPostId())) {
1593                                market.removePerson(curr);
1594                                market.getCommDirectory().removePerson(curr);
1595                        }
1596                }
1597                person.setPostId(postId);
1598                market.addPerson(person);
1599                market.getCommDirectory().addPerson(person);
1600        }
